param.name: ArduCopter:DR_NEXT_MODE
param.documentation: Copter switches to this mode after GPS/EKF recovers. While GPS remains bad, completion or DR_FLY_TIMEOUT levels and holds in Guided_NoGPS using inertial attitude and barometric vertical control. Default is 6/RTL. Set to -1 to return to the mode used before deadreckoning was triggered

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_MODEL_TIME
param.documentation: Uses a physical airspeed sensor, or EK3 drag-model parameters when no sensor measurement is available, plus the last trusted EKF headwind estimate to estimate when the last trusted distance home has been flown. A captured tailwind is not credited because it may disappear after GPS loss. DR_FLY_TIMEOUT remains a hard upper limit.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_DIST_MARGIN
param.documentation: Multiplier applied to the last trusted distance home when using measured ground progress, or to predicted flight time when using the drag model. Values above one intentionally fly farther to tolerate acceleration, stale wind and model error.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_OBS_ENABLE
param.documentation: Enables a GPS-denied horizontal velocity and displacement observer. IMU provides short-term acceleration while throttle, voltage and optional current/RPM constrain the physically possible envelope. Physical airspeed is an optional correction. Vertical control remains barometric.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_OBS_VMAX
param.documentation: Hard horizontal speed limit for the GPS-denied observer. A valid MCAL_VMAX and propulsion scale may lower this limit but can never raise it.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_OBS_AMAX
param.documentation: Hard horizontal acceleration limit. The runtime tilt and propulsion envelope normally impose a lower limit. Samples beyond DR_OBS_CLIP are rejected rather than clipped into persistent acceleration.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_OBS_UNC
param.documentation: Minimum one-sigma horizontal velocity uncertainty growth per second without an independent velocity observation. Conservative return progress subtracts this uncertainty.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_OBS_CLIP
param.documentation: Horizontal IMU acceleration samples above this magnitude are treated as clipping, impact or gross vibration and are not integrated.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_OBS_VIBE
param.documentation: IMU vibration vector magnitude above which horizontal acceleration is not integrated and observer uncertainty grows faster.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_EKF_BRIDGE
param.documentation: After GPS is quarantined, keep the current position-controlled mode while both EKF covariance and the separately bounded observer uncertainty remain within configured limits. The observer is not fused back into EKF. When either estimate becomes unsafe the applet changes to Guided_NoGPS fallback.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_EKF_POS_MAX
param.documentation: Maximum 2D RMS horizontal position uncertainty in metres. The larger of EKF covariance and the separately bounded observer uncertainty is used.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_EKF_VEL_MAX
param.documentation: Maximum one-sigma velocity uncertainty in metres per second. The larger of EKF covariance and the separately bounded observer uncertainty is used.

param.name: ArduCopter:DR_EKF_TIME_MAX
param.documentation: Maximum time that a GPS-dependent mode may continue after GPS is declared bad, even if covariance remains small. Zero disables the bridge and causes immediate Guided_NoGPS fallback.

param.name: ArduCopter:ARSPD_USE
param.documentation: Set to 1 only when a forward-facing pitot is intentionally enabled for EKF3 using EK3_ARSP_MODE. It does not create a fixed-wing throttle controller.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_ENABLE
param.documentation: Enables the experimental ModelCal flight mode. ModelCal commands three pairs of straight, reciprocal, nose-forward legs and requires a large clear flight area, reliable GPS, working altitude control and calm enough conditions to reach steady speed. The mode aborts on GPS degradation, excessive radius, pilot roll/pitch/yaw input or failure to stop between legs.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_ANG1
param.documentation: Forward pitch angle magnitude used for the first reciprocal leg pair.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_ANG2
param.documentation: Forward pitch angle magnitude used for the second reciprocal leg pair.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_ANG3
param.documentation: Forward pitch angle magnitude used for the third reciprocal leg pair.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_SETTLE
param.documentation: Time at the commanded pitch before samples from each leg are used. Increase until speed is nearly steady before sampling starts.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_SAMPLE
param.documentation: Duration of the steady portion averaged for each straight leg.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_RADIUS
param.documentation: Maximum horizontal distance from the point where ModelCal was entered. Exceeding this radius aborts to Loiter, or AltHold/Land if absolute navigation is unavailable.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_APPLY
param.documentation: When enabled, a successful calibration also saves MCAL_BCOEF_X to EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X and MCAL_MCOEF to EK3_DRAG_MCOEF. The lateral coefficient is not changed. Leave disabled until logs and MCAL_QUALITY have been reviewed.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_BCOEF_X
param.documentation: Identified mass-to-drag ratio for quadratic body-X drag, compatible with EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_MCOEF
param.documentation: Identified linear rotor drag coefficient, compatible with EK3_DRAG_MCOEF in the calibrated pitch, speed, thrust and density envelope. Momentum drag can vary with rotor thrust, so a coefficient inferred at a different flight angle need not match.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_QUALITY
param.documentation: Zero to one quality score based on model residual, coefficient uncertainty, fit identifiability, speed settling, cross-track motion and agreement of wind estimates between reciprocal pairs.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_VMAX
param.documentation: Highest inferred body-X true airspeed covered by the calibration. Model use outside this range should increase uncertainty.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_WIND_N
param.documentation: North component of wind inferred by averaging reciprocal ground-velocity vectors. This is diagnostic and is not reused as a persistent flight wind value.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_WIND_E
param.documentation: East component of wind inferred by averaging reciprocal ground-velocity vectors. This is diagnostic and is not reused as a persistent flight wind value.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_THR
param.documentation: Mean normalized throttle during accepted calibration samples, saved as part of the model validity envelope.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_VOLT
param.documentation: Mean primary battery voltage during accepted calibration samples, saved as part of the model validity envelope.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_RPM
param.documentation: Mean RPM sensor value during accepted calibration samples, or zero when no RPM sensor was available.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_ARSP_ERR
param.documentation: Mean absolute disagreement between reciprocal-leg inferred body-X airspeed and a physical airspeed sensor, or zero when no physical sensor was available.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_CURR
param.documentation: Mean primary battery current during accepted calibration samples, or zero when current monitoring was unavailable. This is an optional propulsion-envelope reference and is never treated as a direct speed measurement.

param.name: ArduCopter:MCAL_PWR
param.documentation: Mean primary battery electrical power during accepted calibration samples, or zero when current monitoring was unavailable. Unlike current alone this reference remains comparable as battery voltage and state of charge change.

param.name: EK3_OPTIONS
param.documentation: EKF optional behaviour. Bit 0 (JammingExpected): Setting JammingExpected will change the EKF behaviour such that if dead reckoning navigation is possible it will require the preflight alignment GPS quality checks controlled by EK3_GPS_CHECK and EK3_CHECK_SCALE to pass before resuming GPS use if GPS lock is lost for more than 2 seconds to prevent bad position estimate. Bit 1 (Manual lane switching): DANGEROUS – If enabled, this disables automatic lane switching. If the active lane becomes unhealthy, no automatic switching will occur. Users must manually set EK3_PRIMARY to change lanes. No health checks will be performed on the selected lane. Use with extreme caution. Bit 2 (Optflow may use terrain alt): Terrain SRTM data will be used if the vehicle climbs above the rangefinder's range allowing optical flow to be used at higher altitudes. Bit 3 (AGL KF for optflow scaling): Use a 2-state IMU-aided AGL Kalman filter (height + vertical velocity, fused with rangefinder) to compute the height-above-ground used for optical flow velocity scaling, instead of terrainState-pd. This decouples optical flow scaling from errors in the main filter's vertical position state. Bit 4 (GPSQuarantine): Rejects GPS position, velocity and height after a large disagreement or data outage and requires a continuous probation period before GPS can modify EKF states again. This is experimental and does not make a single GPS receiver cryptographically trustworthy.
param.field: 0:JammingExpected, 1:ManualLaneSwitching, 2:Optflow may use terrain alt, 3:AGL KF for optflow scaling, 4:GPS quarantine

param.name: EK3_ARSP_MODE
param.documentation: Controls how EKF3 interprets scalar airspeed measurements. Default fuses true airspeed magnitude only for vehicles that explicitly use the fly-forward zero-sideslip model. BodyXWind interprets a forward pitot as the positive body-X component of air-relative velocity and updates wind states only. BodyXNav additionally permits horizontal velocity correction after absolute position and velocity aiding have timed out. The BodyX modes are experimental, require a forward-facing sensor and a vehicle that is operated nose-forward, and reject measurements during reverse flow, excessive off-axis flow or rapid rotation. They never enable the fixed-wing zero-sideslip assumption.

param.name: EK3_GPS_Q_POS
param.documentation: Maximum horizontal disagreement between a GPS measurement and the delayed EKF prediction that the optional GPS quarantine monitor accepts. A larger value makes recovery after long GPS outages easier but also admits larger spoofed position changes. This hard gate is not enlarged using receiver-reported accuracy because a spoofed receiver can also falsify its accuracy estimate.

param.name: EK3_GPS_Q_VEL
param.documentation: Maximum horizontal disagreement between GPS velocity and the delayed EKF velocity prediction accepted by the optional GPS quarantine monitor.

param.name: EK3_GPS_Q_TIME
param.documentation: Continuous time for which returned GPS position, velocity and receiver quality must remain plausible before the optional quarantine monitor permits GPS fusion and state resets again. Recovery with a stable position offset after a data gap uses twice this time. A continuous position rejection cannot use offset recovery.

param.name: EK3_GPS_Q_OFS
param.documentation: Maximum horizontal disagreement allowed when GPS returns after a real data gap. The returned coordinate trajectory and velocity must still agree with the inertial prediction throughout an extended probation period. This exception is never used after a continuous position rejection and never applies to GPS height, which remains checked against the barometer-aided vertical state. Set this only large enough to cover expected horizontal dead-reckoning drift.
